hypothesis_contract.null: Keeping the V25 RAW signal definition and fixed 1/7 sleeves while executing one causally cheapest representative per basket does not make both normal and adverse full comparable months reach 2.0x.
hypothesis_contract.alternative: The one-rule execution mask reduces realized cost and turnover enough for both normal and adverse full comparable months to reach at least 2.0x without leverage, period, or holdout changes.

training_only_rule_selection.selection_basis: V25 identified cost dominance. Training-only quote-spread inputs showed a defined causal ordering for every observed basket; no return, direction-accuracy, drawdown, monthly-multiple, or future-exit outcome was consulted.

deterministic_rule.name: CAUSAL_MIN_SPREAD_REPRESENTATIVE
deterministic_rule.score_formula: score_s_bps = median_k(2 * 10000 * (ask_close_k - bid_close_k) / ((ask_close_k + bid_close_k) / 2)) for the 20 completed same-pair M5 bars ending at decision_time_s
deterministic_rule.selection_formula: selected_signal_id_d = argmin over V25 RAW signals in basket d of (score_s_bps, signal_id_s)
deterministic_rule.entry_use: The selected V25 signal keeps its original pair, direction, decision_time and 06:00 fill_time.
deterministic_rule.exit_use: The selected V25 signal keeps its original 11:55 exit_time and finite max-age.
deterministic_rule.inventory_use: Only the selected signal opens one fixed 1/7 sleeve; six sleeves remain cash and are not reallocated.
deterministic_rule.direction_use: The rule never creates, flips, or ranks direction; direction is inherited byte-for-byte from V25 RAW_SIGNAL.
deterministic_rule.cost_arm_use: The execution-selected mask is computed once and reused unchanged by RAW_SIGNAL, EXECUTABLE_BASE and ADVERSE_STRESS. Cost is never used to suppress or alter the RAW signal ledger.
deterministic_rule.chronology: Every score input row is complete and has timestamp <= decision_time. Fill and exit bars and any later outcome are unavailable to the selector.

system_fail: parent V25 seal, result, ledger or signal-id hash mismatch
any RAW signal id, definition, pair, direction, decision_time, fill_time or exit_time change
any score input after decision_time or any incomplete BID/ASK row
execution mask differs across cost arms
source BID/ASK hash or completed chronology mismatch
inventory, max-age, terminal liquidation, terminal MTM, restart safety or zero-authority failure
evaluation period, leverage or profit thresholds changed
rejection_conditions.profit_reject: Automatically reject if either full comparable month is below 2.0x in EXECUTABLE_BASE or ADVERSE_STRESS, or unopened holdout reproduction is absent.
rejection_conditions.stretch_not_required_for_minimum: 3.0x is reported separately and never substituted for the 2.0x minimum.
